whatsapp_message: Hi Loyara, I saw your post and want a free consultation.

morning.focus: Get leads. Pick a problem a business owner feels today (no enquiries, inconsistent posting, ads that burn money, a website that doesn't convert), show you understand it with one sharp insight, and point to the fix: a free consultation with Loyara.

evening.focus: Drive website traffic and enquiries. When a fresh blog article is given, tease its most useful takeaways and send people to read it. Otherwise make a direct, friendly offer or a strong opinion that makes people want to talk to us.

linkedin.pattern: alternate daily: sales, then educational, then sales...

sales.label: Problem → solution
sales.brief: Name a costly problem business owners have (no consistent content, no enquiries from social, a website that doesn't convert, ads wasting money). Explain why it happens, how Loyara fixes it (from the fact sheet), and invite them to book a free consultation.

sales.label: Service spotlight
sales.brief: Spotlight ONE service or package (rotate: Growth plan, Elite plan, Starter plan, websites, Meta Ads, brand identity). Say exactly what's included, who it's for and the result it's built for, with the price from the fact sheet (no INR prices for websites aimed at international readers). Close with a clear call to book.

sales.label: How we work / trust
sales.brief: Remove the fear of hiring an agency: show how Loyara works (free consultation, approved calendar, content days, reporting, 50/50 payment) and why that protects the client. End with a direct invitation to book a free consultation or DM.

education.label: Practical tip
education.brief: Teach one practical, specific thing a business owner can do this week to get more from social media or reels (e.g. a hook formula, what to film on a shoot day, how to plan a month of posts). Give the steps. No sales pitch: at most one soft line at the end that Loyara does this for clients.

education.label: Website / Meta Ads lesson
education.brief: Explain one concept about websites or Meta Ads that business owners get wrong (e.g. boost vs real campaigns, what a landing page needs above the fold, why a site loses mobile visitors). Write for business owners anywhere in the world. Teach clearly, with a simple example. No pitch.

education.label: AI in marketing, explained
education.brief: Explain, in plain words, how a small business can use AI in its marketing today (e.g. drafting captions, research, ad targeting ideas), and where a human still matters. Only describe well-known, general capabilities; do not claim specific new launches, features, prices or dates unless they appear in the website or blog content in this brief. No pitch.

education.label: Lesson from our latest blog article
education.brief: Teach the 3 most useful takeaways from the blog article below, in your own words, using only what the article says. End by inviting readers to read the full article (link in the first comment).
